note: overAttributed = segments at index >= 1 of a chain whose ROOT identifier the file types with `new T()`. collectFieldAccessUses publishes owner=<root type> on EVERY segment of the chain (cur/head are taken from the root, outside the segment loop), but only index 0's receiver IS the typed root. resolvableWrong = those segments whose name the root's own type DECLARES in the same file, which is the exact condition under which the store's owner pass (resolveMemberTargetsByOwner) binds the edge to a declaration the receiver is not. declaredElsewhere = the name exists on a different class in the file, so the owner pass declines instead of binding.
